registrations.title: Registrations
registrations.subtitle: Requests from the website. Check the details, then create the restaurant account in one step.
registrations.empty: New requests from the website will show up here.
registrations.whatsappText: Hello {{name}}, this is Manhar Nexus. We received your request ({{ref}}).

account.title: Create restaurant account for {{name}}
account.intro: One click: the restaurant, its first location, the owner login and the modules are created on our server. If a step fails, Retry continues from it and nothing is created twice.
account.paidNote: Payment received. The account will be marked Active.
account.unpaidNote: No payment is recorded for this request yet.
account.pilot: Create it anyway as a free pilot (Trial)
account.needsPaymentOrPilot: Wait for the payment, or tick the free pilot option.
account.working: Setting everything up. Please keep this window open.
account.stopped: A step failed. Nothing is lost: Retry continues from that step.
account.fixEmail: Owner email (change it if it is wrong or already used)

step.finalize: Issue the temporary password and mark the request done

account.readyBody: Send these details to the owner. They must change the password at first sign-in.
account.shownOnce: The password is shown only now and is not stored. Copy it before you close this window.
account.lost: Closed too early? Issue a new password (works until the owner signs in).
account.failedGeneric: Could not create the account. Please try again.
account.alreadyDone: The account already exists. Use the button below if the password was lost.

registrations.prefillNote: From website request {{ref}}. Details are filled in; check them, then create.
registrations.converted: {{name}} is ready. Share the sign-in details with the owner.

errors.load: Check your connection and try again.
errors.linkFailed: The restaurant was created, but this request could not be marked done. Open it again and mark it manually.

payment.title: Payment link for {{name}}
payment.intro: Cashfree emails the owner a secure link to pay. You also get the link to share on WhatsApp. When it is paid, this request shows Paid and you can create the account.
payment.mismatchHint: Paid ₹{{paid}}, expected ₹{{expected}}. Check this payment in Cashfree, then refund or agree the difference with the owner.
payment.launchPackIncluded: The Launch Pack (setup help) is included in this price.
payment.launchPack: Add the Launch Pack (setup help; included in Pass and in Founding yearly plans)
payment.pickPlan: Choose a plan first, or type an amount.
payment.pickPlanHint: The owner picked "{{plan}}", which has no fixed price. Choose a plan above, or type an amount.
payment.reasonHint: For example: agreed on the phone, Many Doors custom quote. This is saved with the link.
payment.reasonInvalid: Write a short reason (at least 3 letters).
payment.replaceOpen: This request already has an open payment link. Cancel it and create this new one instead.
payment.amountHint: What the owner pays, in rupees, for example 1500 or 1499.50.
payment.amountInvalid: Enter an amount above ₹0 with at most two decimals.
payment.createFailed: Could not create the payment link. Please try again.
payment.ready: The link for ₹{{amount}} is ready. It stays valid for 7 days.
payment.paidHint: Paid. Create the restaurant account now.
payment.checkFailed: Could not check with Cashfree. Please try again.

checked.paid: Payment received. Create the restaurant account now.
checked.amount-mismatch: A payment came in, but the amount does not match. Check it in Cashfree.
